text:
rachel_onboard: Mendota Health returned the vendor intake. Key asks: DPA addendum, SOC2 excerpt, BYOK support, and explicit wording around embeddings containing health data. Procurement wants a short matrix + attestation by Tue EOD.

omar_cs: Uploaded intake to the thread (mendota_packet.pdf). They are nervous about PHI in embeddings and want a guarantee embeddings won't be stored outside the EU if they use our service.

diego_se: Quick answer: BYOK is supported for Dedicated and Private deployments via AWS/GCP KMS integrations. Hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys only; no BYOK.

frida_security: I can produce a 1-paragraph attestation confirming supported KMS integrations and pointing to SOC2 controls. Also will include evidence links.

ops_bot: Ticket created: CS-4902 1 Mendota vendor intake. Assigned to @frida_security, due 2026-04-10.

diego_se: On embeddings residency: Hosted requests are routed by latency/cost policy and may use multiple regions. To guarantee EU-only embeddings/indexes, customer must use Dedicated/Private provisioned in EU and enable customer-managed keys.

omar_cs: Mendota specifically asked: "Can you disable embeddings persistence on hosted so nothing is written?"

diego_se: We offer an experimental opt-out flag for hosted that sets embeddings.persist=false (ephemeral). It requires SRE approval and is not covered by production SLA for PHI. Dedicated/Private supports immediate controls.

frida_security: Draft attestation: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments via AWS KMS and GCP KMS. Customers retain key provenance. Redwood-managed keys rotate under our SOC2 controls. For evidence see internal KMS integration guide and SOC2 summary."

omar_cs: Can someone assemble a 3-row matrix (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with yes/no for BYOK, EU-only embeddings guarantee, and path to evidence? I'll format and send to procurement once attestation is final.

diego_se: I'll post a sample Dedicated config snippet and a curl example for hosted ephemeral embeddings.

ops_bot: Reminder: CS-4902 due in 72 hours.

rachel_onboard: Plan: Diego posts snippets, Frida finalizes attestation, Omar compiles matrix and sends to Legal for a quick review, then responds to Mendota. Thanks team :thumbsup:
